sandbox.name: Docker sandbox
sandbox.impact: Nightly experiments cannot run in Docker. The Night Desk website and saved reports may still work.
sandbox.step: Start Docker on your Mac. If it is already running, check why the heartbeat cannot reach it. Wait up to a minute, then refresh its status.

mac.name: Mac heartbeat
mac.impact: Night Desk cannot confirm that the Mac can pick up jobs or manual tests.
mac.step: Wake the Mac and check its internet connection. If it is already online, check the Night Desk heartbeat service.

clickhouse.name: ClickHouse
clickhouse.impact: Nightly data sync or analysis may fail.
clickhouse.step: Check ClickHouse access from the Mac, using the same account and tables as the nightly run. Then test again.

langfuse.name: Langfuse
langfuse.impact: Saving or viewing nightly traces and scores is not verified.
langfuse.step: Check the Langfuse project, service access and ingestion result on the Mac. Then test again.

pastdev.name: past.dev
pastdev.impact: The nightly memory service may be unavailable.
pastdev.step: Check the memory service credentials and account access on the Mac. Then refresh status.

jev.name: Jev
jev.impact: Nightly model access or judgment may be unavailable.
jev.step: Check the configured Jev account, endpoint and model access on the Mac. Then refresh status.

auth.name: Night Desk sign-in
auth.impact: Your current Night Desk account could not be verified.
auth.step: Check this device’s internet connection. If sign-in has expired, sign in again.

database.name: Supabase database
database.impact: Night Desk may be unable to read your reports.
database.step: Check the database connection and your account’s access to reports. Then refresh status.

approvals.name: Approvals
approvals.impact: Approving or undoing changes may be unavailable.
approvals.step: Check your Night Desk sign-in and approval passkey setup in Settings.

hosting.name: Night Desk hosting
hosting.impact: The backend could not verify the website deployment.
hosting.step: Check the production deployment and its public health endpoint. Then refresh status.

codex.name: Codex
codex.impact: A nightly Codex subscription call has not been verified.
codex.step: Open Codex on your Mac and check its sign-in, selected model and subscription allowance. Then test again.

claude.name: Claude
claude.impact: A nightly Claude subscription call has not been verified.
claude.step: Open Claude on your Mac and check its sign-in, selected model and subscription allowance. Then test again.
